newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan complains to Security Council over Eritrea.
newsitem.headline: Sudan complains to Security Council over Eritrea.

text.p: Sudan complained to the United Nations Security Council that Eritrea had launched attacks across their border, the official Sudanese news agency SUNA said on Sunday.
The complaint lodged on Saturday followed what Sudanese officials said were statements made by Eritrean President Isayas Afewerki that indicated his country had attacked Sudan, it said.
"The confession by the president of the Eritrean regime confirms the evidence already present of Eritrea's involvement," SUNA quoted Foreign Minister Ali Osman Mohammad Taha as saying.
The agency said Taha had lodged similiar complaints to the Arab League, the Organisation of African Unity and the Organisation of the Islamic Conference.
Khartoum has accused Eritrea, Ethiopia and Uganda of helping northern and southern rebels launch anti-government attacks in the northeast and the south. All three countries deny the charge.
